ciInvestigation.symptom: verify job on head 54300b4 hit the single 15-minute job timeout with no step producing log output; earlier heads on the same branch had passed.
ciInvestigation.localRepro: Ran pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, verify:toolchain, lint (27s cold), typecheck, vitest, node --test scripts/compute/compute.test.mjs, build.mjs --check and pnpm build individually on this exact head: all passed in well under a minute each, no infinite loop or hang reproduced in any script.
ciInvestigation.conclusion: No code-level hang found. The job had one shared 15-minute budget across 9 steps with no per-step limit, so a single slow or stuck step (most likely a flaky pnpm install against the npm registry on the runner) could silently consume the whole budget and leave zero step logs. Fixed by giving each step its own timeout-minutes (install 5, toolchain 2, lint 3, typecheck 3, test 3, editorial planner 2, compute verify 2, build 5) so a future hang fails fast and points at the exact step, instead of raising the job timeout without evidence.

staticAudit390and375px: Hero, status list and section heads use clamp()/flex-wrap and already ship at 390/375 px elsewhere on this page; unchanged by this PR.
Stack planner form (.plannerGrid, .checkboxGrid) collapses to a single column under the existing 760 px breakpoint; number/select inputs are width:100% inside their field, no fixed pixel widths.
Preset buttons (.presetRow) wrap via flex-wrap and go full-width at <=760 px via the existing media query addition.
Result cards (.plannerResults) use minmax(min(100%,260px),1fr), so each card is capped to the viewport width and stacks on a phone; no fixed width exceeds the container.

Both new tables (fit-by-class, line-by-line memory) reuse the existing .tableWrap pattern: overflow-x: auto on a focusable region with role="region", min-width: 620px on the inner table. The table itself scrolls sideways inside that bounded container; the page body does not acquire horizontal scroll from it.
No row introduces unwrapped long text: result-card prose is plain paragraphs with no nowrap or fixed width, so it wraps at any viewport.
